user.title: TCL TV
user.description: The TV must be on and reachable (UDP 6537 / TCP 6553).

error.cannot_connect: No TCL remote service answered at this address. Is the TV on?

send_text.name: Send text
send_text.description: Send text to the TV via IME (message ID 155). The TV must have focus on a text input field before calling this service.

text.name: Text
text.description: The text to send to the TV. Text containing '>>' may have parsing issues.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target entity (remote or media_player). If not specified, sends to all configured TCL TVs.
